errors.text_span: Das Diagramm stellt die monatliche Summe der zurückliegenden zwölf Monate eines Ausfuhrüberschusses für Industrieerzeugnisse in China dar.
errors.evidence: The description conflates the two separate data series shown in the chart ('monthly' and 'sum of the last twelve months') into a single, confusing introductory sentence.
The x-axis in the figure ranges from July 2014 (07/2014) to July 2024 (07/2024), not from July 2015 to December 2023.
The left y-axis is labeled 'Mrd. US-$', which stands for Milliarden (billions) of US dollars, not millions.
The blue line in the chart is a solid line with no markers; it does not have triangle markers.

errors.text_span: steigt von 60 Milliarden US-Dollar im Juli 2015 auf 180 Milliarden US-Dollar im Dezember 2019, fällt dann auf 80 Milliarden US-Dollar im Februar 2021, und erreicht im Dezember 2023 einen Höchstwert von 200 Milliarden US-Dollar, bevor sie auf 180 Milliarden US-Dollar im Dezember 2023 sinkt.
errors.evidence: The description consistently reads the values for the blue line from the left axis instead of the correct right axis. For example, in July 2015, the value is approximately 1,000 billion US dollars (right axis), not 60. The peak is over 1,800 billion, not 200 billion.
The purple line in the chart is a solid line with no markers; it does not have circle markers.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 50 Milliarden US-Dollar im Juli 2015
errors.evidence: The purple line begins in July 2014 at a value of approximately 90 billion US dollars, not in July 2015 at 50 billion.
The phrase 'in an economic pattern' is subjective and interpretive, not a direct description of the visual data.

errors.text_span: bis zu einem Tiefststand von 20 Milliarden US-Dollar im Februar 2020
errors.evidence: The lowest point for the purple line is around July 2020, where it drops to approximately -20 billion US dollars, not a positive 20 billion in February 2020.

errors.text_span: steigt dann auf 190 Mill. US-Dollar im Dezember 2022
errors.evidence: The unit 'Mill.' (millions) is incorrect; it should be 'Mrd.' (billions). Additionally, the peak value for the purple line is approximately 180 billion around July 2022, not 190 billion in December 2022.

errors.text_span: fällt wieder auf 150 Mill. US-Dollar im Dezember 2023
errors.evidence: The unit 'Mill.' (millions) is incorrect. The value in December 2023 (approx. 01/2024 on the axis) is around 170 billion US dollars, not 150 billion.
